.whats-link {
  position: fixed;
  bottom:15px;
  top: auto;
  left: 15px;
  right: auto;
  z-index: 999;
}
.popup-whats{
  position: relative;
}
.popup-whats .btn-close{
  position: absolute;
  right: -8px;
  top: -8px;
  background-color: #fafafa;
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;  
  padding: 8px;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0;
  opacity: 0.8;
  color: #9e9f9f;
  z-index: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.popup-whats .btn-close:hover{
  opacity: 1;
  color: #2c3847;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.whats-link .main-button-whats figure{
  margin-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 16px;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.whats-link .main-button-whats {
  background-color: transparent;
  /* border-radius: 16px; */
  padding: 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: "Inter-Bold", "sans-serif";
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-stretch: normal;
  line-height: 24px;
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.whats-link .main-button-whats:hover {
  /* opacity: 0.7;*/
  filter: drop-shadow(0px 5px 5px rgba(0, 0, 30, 0.8));
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.whats-link .main-button-whats figure.figure-mobile {
  display: none;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 991.98px) {

}

  .whats-link .main-button-whats figure {
    display: none;

  .whats-link .main-button-whats figure.figure-mobile{
    display: block;
  }
}

.whats-link {
max-width: 100px;
}

    }

    /* Click function */

      var value = $(this).val().toLowerCase();

      $.ajax({
        url: "capa_acesso_rapido_ajax.php?input_pesquisa=" + pesquisa,
        beforeSend: function(xhr) {
          $(reloadData).html('<div class="col-12 text-center"><i class="fa fa-circle-o-notch fa-spin fa-3x fa-fw"></i><span class="sr-only">Carregando...</span></div>');

      }).done(function(data) {
        $(reloadData).html(data);
      });
    }

    /* Click function */
    $('input[name="input_search_servicos"]').on('keyup', function() {
      var value = $(this).val().toLowerCase();
      realoadAcessoRapido(value, '#realoadAcessoRapido');

    /*WHATS*/
.whats-link {
  position: fixed;
  bottom:15px;
  top: auto;
  left: 15px;
  right: auto;
  z-index: 999;
}
.popup-whats{
  position: relative;
}
.popup-whats .btn-close{
  position: absolute;
  right: -8px;
  top: -8px;
  background-color: #fafafa;
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;  
  padding: 8px;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0;
  opacity: 0.8;
  color: #9e9f9f;
  z-index: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.popup-whats .btn-close:hover{
  opacity: 1;
  color: #2c3847;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.whats-link .main-button-whats figure{
  margin-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 16px;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.whats-link .main-button-whats {
  background-color: transparent;
  /* border-radius: 16px; */
  padding: 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: "Inter-Bold", "sans-serif";
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-stretch: normal;
  line-height: 24px;
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.whats-link .main-button-whats:hover {
  /* opacity: 0.7;*/
  filter: drop-shadow(0px 5px 5px rgba(0, 0, 30, 0.8));
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.whats-link .main-button-whats figure.figure-mobile {
  display: none;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 991.98px) {

}


@media screen and (max-width: 767.9px) {

  .whats-link .main-button-whats figure {
    display: none;
  }
  .whats-link .main-button-whats figure.figure-mobile{
    display: block;
  }
}
@media screen and (max-width: 575.9px) {

.whats-link {
max-width: 100px;
}

}

  $(document).ready(function() {
    function realoadAcessoRapido(pesquisa, reloadData) {
      $.ajax({
        url: "capa_acesso_rapido_ajax.php?input_pesquisa=" + pesquisa,
        beforeSend: function(xhr) {
          $(reloadData).html('<div class="col-12 text-center"><i class="fa fa-circle-o-notch fa-spin fa-3x fa-fw"></i><span class="sr-only">Carregando...</span></div>');
        }
      }).done(function(data) {
        $(reloadData).html(data);
      });
    }

    /* Click function */
    $('input[name="input_search_servicos"]').on('keyup', function() {
      var value = $(this).val().toLowerCase();
      realoadAcessoRapido(value, '#realoadAcessoRapido');
    })
  });

    /*WHATS*/
.whats-link {
  position: fixed;
  bottom:15px;
  top: auto;
  left: 15px;
  right: auto;
  z-index: 999;
}
.popup-whats{
  position: relative;
}
.popup-whats .btn-close{
  position: absolute;
  right: -8px;
  top: -8px;
  background-color: #fafafa;
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;  
  padding: 8px;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0;
  opacity: 0.8;
  color: #9e9f9f;
  z-index: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.popup-whats .btn-close:hover{
  opacity: 1;
  color: #2c3847;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.whats-link .main-button-whats figure{
  margin-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 16px;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.whats-link .main-button-whats {
  background-color: transparent;
  /* border-radius: 16px; */
  padding: 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: "Inter-Bold", "sans-serif";
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-stretch: normal;
  line-height: 24px;
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.whats-link .main-button-whats:hover {
  /* opacity: 0.7;*/
  filter: drop-shadow(0px 5px 5px rgba(0, 0, 30, 0.8));
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.whats-link .main-button-whats figure.figure-mobile {
  display: none;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 991.98px) {

}


@media screen and (max-width: 767.9px) {

  .whats-link .main-button-whats figure {
    display: none;
  }
  .whats-link .main-button-whats figure.figure-mobile{
    display: block;
  }
}
@media screen and (max-width: 575.9px) {

.whats-link {
max-width: 100px;
}

    /*WHATS*/
.whats-link {
  position: fixed;
  bottom:15px;
  top: auto;
  left: 15px;
  right: auto;
  z-index: 999;
}
.popup-whats{
  position: relative;
}
.popup-whats .btn-close{
  position: absolute;
  right: -8px;
  top: -8px;
  background-color: #fafafa;
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;  
  padding: 8px;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0;
  opacity: 0.8;
  color: #9e9f9f;
  z-index: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.popup-whats .btn-close:hover{
  opacity: 1;
  color: #2c3847;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.whats-link .main-button-whats figure{
  margin-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 16px;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.whats-link .main-button-whats {
  background-color: transparent;
  /* border-radius: 16px; */
  padding: 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: "Inter-Bold", "sans-serif";
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-stretch: normal;
  line-height: 24px;
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}
.whats-link .main-button-whats:hover {
  /* opacity: 0.7;*/
  filter: drop-shadow(0px 5px 5px rgba(0, 0, 30, 0.8));
  -webkit-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -moz-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -ms-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  -o-transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
  transition: 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.whats-link .main-button-whats figure.figure-mobile {
  display: none;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 991.98px) {

}


@media screen and (max-width: 767.9px) {

  .whats-link .main-button-whats figure {
    display: none;
  }
  .whats-link .main-button-whats figure.figure-mobile{
    display: block;
  }
}
@media screen and (max-width: 575.9px) {

.whats-link {
max-width: 100px;
}

}
